hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/little-pine-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880114 (all 71 Modern Electric sites list 50-amp; no site lists water or sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: The booking site lists 97 campsites (71 Modern Electric, 19 Modern Non-Electric, 7 Modern Tent Only) besides cottages, yurts and group tenting; DCNR says 88 campsites, 83 of them for 'trailer units up to 20 feet in length'. The booking site's per-site max vehicle lengths are larger: on the electric sites 37 list 40 ft, 18 list 30, 12 list 20 and 4 list 50 (nonelectric 15-40). Two electric sites (28, 35) are pull-through. The two official pages disagree on length; max_rig_ft follows the per-site listings.

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window; season (first weekend of April to mid-December) already manual and restated by DCNR. Added 50-amp electric (water/sewer not listed, left unknown), 97 campsites up to 50 ft with two pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/water/dump. ReserveAmerica tags 28 RV sites 'Waterfront' (incl. 85-88), consistent with the stored creekside and the --AWH note. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
flags: Size statements conflict: DCNR's stay page says '83 sites can accommodate trailer units up to 20 feet in length', which would fail the 23-ft rule, while ReserveAmerica's per-site catalog lists 40 ft on 37 electric sites and 50 ft on four. The family has stayed here (--AWH note), so the 20-ft line is probably stale; recorded max_rig_ft 50 from the per-site catalog and noted DCNR's figure. A human may want to confirm.
